name: LOADPADB.JCL
description:
This JCL job (LOADPADB) executes an IMS Batch Message Processing (BMP) program named PAUDBLOD using the PSB PSBPAUTB to load payment authorization database records into an IMS database. The job reads two sequential input files — a root segment file and a child segment file — and populates the corresponding IMS database segments.Key Functionalities:
Reads root-level payment authorization records from the input sequential file (PAUTDB ROOT) and loads them as root IMS segments into the payment authorization IMS database.
Reads child-level payment authorization records from the input sequential file (PAUTDB CHILD) and loads them as child IMS segments linked to their respective root segments.
Utilizes the IMS BMP region (DFSRRC00) with PSB PSBPAUTB to manage database access and enforce IMS segment hierarchy during the load process.
References IMS PSB and DBD libraries to resolve the database structure definitions required for the load operation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Root (parent/header) Payment Authorization records are available and ready in INFILE1 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO) AND Child (dependent/detail) Payment Authorization records are available and ready in INFILE2 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.CHILD.FILEO), both accessible in shared read-only mode, AND the IMS Payment Authorization Program Specification Block (PSBPAUTB) is available defining the authorized database segments and hierarchical access paths
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Payment Authorization Database Batch Load program (PAUDBLOD) is executed in IMS Batch Message Processing (BMP) mode with access governed by PSBPAUTB
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program reads Root Payment Authorization records from INFILE1 and loads them as top-level (parent) segments into the IMS Payment Authorization Database, AND reads Child Payment Authorization records from INFILE2 and loads them as subordinate (dependent) segments linked to their respective parent root records, resulting in the IMS Payment Authorization Database being fully populated with a complete hierarchical parent-child record structure; all processing messages and any IMS errors are captured in system output logs for operational review

rules.Rule_Name: STEP01 - PAUDBLOD - Load Payment Authorization Database with Hierarchical Records
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the Payment Authorization Database Batch Load program (PAUDBLOD) through the IMS Batch Message Processing (BMP) framework. It reads Root (parent/header) Payment Authorization records and Child (dependent/detail) Payment Authorization records from two pre-generated input files and loads them as a hierarchical structure into the IMS Payment Authorization Database, governed by the Payment Authorization Program Specification Block (PSBPAUTB).
